PUNIT VISHWAKARMA Lead Consultant 8805788192 punitvishwakarmabusiness555@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/punitvishwakarma

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Investment Banking professional with more than a decade of expertise in Data Governance, Data Management and Quality, and Firmwide Regulatory Reporting. Currently, as part of Genpact's Risk Consulting division leading firm-wide Regulatory Reporting and Data Remediation projects.

Competencies and Skills

Analytical thinking, Business Acumen, Decision-Making, Risk Identification and Assessment, Problem-Solving, Presentation, Stakeholder Management, Escalation Management, Data Analysis, Python, SQL, VBA, Statistical Analysis System - SAS, Atlan, Alation, Power BI, Qlik-Sense, Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, JIRA, Confluence, Collibra.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Genpact Enterprise Risk Consulting LLP Lead Consultant, Top-Tier Investment Bank headquartered Broadway, NY, U.S.

Mumbai 07/2024 - Present

Led team of 5 AGILE Business Analysts to implement firmwide APAC regulatory reforms with Go-Live Q4 2025. • Collaborated with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Risk, Product & Data Owners, and Technology to define Critical Data Element (CDEs), System Data Element (SDEs), Data Lineage, Data Retention Policies, Business Requirements, and Regulatory Submission models.

Data analysed for more than 1,000 data elements, reviewed data lineage tracing source systems, data classification, and data quality controls supporting regulatory reporting obligations, including Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) and Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) frameworks.

Co-operated with firm’s Trade Repository partner – DTCC & Industry members to business logics and derivation for complex data elements. • In collaboration with Chapter Lead, Scrum Master, and PMO planned sprints, story points, SDLC approval and JIRA tickets with business logics. • Initiated possible solutions for challenges, Root cause analysis, process risk controls, RAID logs, key metrics - KPIs, Dashboard, and other relevant matters in Senior Stakeholder forums.

Participated in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) testing, reviewed test scripts, data quality checks, KYC and client/ market reference data mapping. • Successfully deployed Regulatory Tech application capable to report transaction details for 3 regions - APAC, EMEA, NAM; 5 different jurisdictions/ regimes

HKMA, MAS, JFSA, EMIR, CFTC; 5 major asset classes - Derivatives, Equities, Forex, Commodities and Credit.

eClerx Services Limited Associate Manager

Navi Mumbai 10/2020 - 06/2024

Directly responsible for 2 teams; Static Data & Risk Operations and Prime Brokerage – Draft and Confirmation, with total headcount of 23 Analysts and Senior Analysts supporting globally across 3 regions: APAC, EMEA, and NAM for Top-Tier Investment Bank headquartered in Greenwich Street, NY, U.S.

Oversaw the setup and maintenance of ETD contracts, OTC contracts, Fixed Income Bonds, and Money Market securities by leveraging market data suppliers

such as Bloomberg, DTCC, Thomson Reuters, etc., ensuring data accuracy, quality, and completeness.

Increased process execution and approval by 10% of agreements detailing key elements - rates, price, dates, clearing agent, broker name, etc. to support

ISDA and Master Agreement drafting in collaboration with Legal and Market Trade Operations.

Managed reconciliation and due diligence/ audit checks of internal and client accounts in collaboration with cross-functional teams – KYC and AML, Risk and

Internal Audit to stay compliant with Sarbanes-Oxley Act, 2002 (SOX).

Co-Managed Firmwide Regulatory Reporting Projects; 1) Common Reporting (COREP) and Financial Reporting (FINREP) after data concerns raised by EBA. 2)

In response to Matter Requiring Attention (MRAs) raised by Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) - outlined in projects section.

With Enterprise Chief Data Office, Liquidity and Treasury departments remediated firm's core system responsible for calculating Risk Weighted Asset (RWA)

to stay compliant with Basel Accords (BCBS 239), FR 2052a and Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) and Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR).

Structured, implemented, and supervised Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) safeguarding business operations and ensuring rapid recovery protocols. • Maintained robust stakeholder relationships via consistent communication channels, promptly addressing challenges and documenting successful Corrective Action Plans (CAPs).

Managed resource utilization by tracking billed and buffer FTEs, strategically optimizing team deployment and reducing overhead across 3 regions. • Analysed and presented key performance Metrics, translating complex data from KPIs, SLAs, timeliness, and utilization reports into actionable insights for client and senior management reviews in Monthly Business Review (MBR), Quarterly Business Review (QBR).

eClerx Services Limited Senior Analyst

Navi Mumbai 11/2019 - 09/2020

Part of Enterprise Chief Data Office's Firmwide Regulatory Remediation and Regulatory Reporting team with major focus on 5 regulatory agencies; Federal

Reserve Board (FRB), Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) and Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Partnered extensively with cross-functional teams including Technology, Liquidity, Risk, and Treasury/Finance. The collaboration focused on understanding

data sources and lineage and aligning regulatory reporting data points with their respective owners for a comprehensive Data Taxonomy.

Sourced more than 10000 legal documentations such as Loan/Credit Agreements, Trade Confirmations, Trade Tickets/Blotters, ISDA/Master Agreements,

etc., to ascertain the reported values are in sync and complying with regulatory standards for reports; FR Y-14, FR 2052a, FR Y-9C, CCAR, LCR, COREP, and FINREP.

Collaborated with Internal Audit (IA) and Independent Compliance (ICRM) teams for Quality and Assurance testing periodically demonstrating robust internal business controls and checks.

Trained and helped junior team members in data analysis leveraging Data Governance and Business Intelligence tools; Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Collibra, etc. • Collaborated with other Senior Analysts for business documentation; Standard Operating Procedure (SOPs), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Executive Draft and Summary, etc.

Maintained key metrics exhibiting progress for each regulatory remediation program - KPIs, SLAs, Dashboard for Senior Stakeholders and Direct Managers.

Career Break Off-Duty Due To Medical Emergency In Family

01/2019 - 10/2019

WORK EXPERIENCE

State Street Analyst

Navi Mumbai 11/2015 - 12/2018

Assisted on setting up financial securities such as Fixed Income Bond – Corporate and Government Bonds/ Sovereign Bonds, Futures, Options, and Money

Market securities (MMKT) - Treasury Bills (T-Bills), Commercial Paper (CPs) in client systems.

Reconciled and verified security information with market data providers including Bloomberg and DTCC. • Collaborated with the trade management team in remediating security setup issues to streamline straight-through processing (STP) of trades. • Performed daily, weekly, and monthly enterprise business risk system checks for data-related concerns across asset classes. • Monitored and Reported daily trade volume to the trade booking and treasury departments for regulatory submission. • Took Initiative for updating Standard Operating Procedures and obtained quarterly Sign-Off from Stakeholders. • Ensured timely delivery of End-of-Day reports to Stakeholders. Mumbai 07/2014 - 10/2015

Reconciled and verified security information with market data providers including Bloomberg and DTCC. • Collaborated with the trade management team in remediating security setup issues to streamline straight-through processing (STP) of trades. • Performed daily, weekly, and monthly enterprise business risk system checks for data-related concerns across asset classes. • Monitored and Reported daily trade volume to the trade booking and treasury departments for regulatory submission. • Took Initiative for updating Standard Operating Procedures and obtained quarterly Sign-Off from Stakeholders. • Ensured timely delivery of End-of-Day reports to Stakeholders. Mumbai 07/2014 - 10/2015

Assisted in accounts payable and accounts receivable. • Assisted in documentation and filings. • Clients' profile/ account reviewed and checked. • Reconciled financial report and recorded in Tally. • Communicating with clients via emails and letters. • Collections and deposits; cheques, bills.

Projects for Top-Tier Investment Bank headquartered in Greenwich Street, NY, U.S.

COREP and FINREP - EMEA entities focused

06/2023 - 12/2023

Co-managed firm-wide regulatory remediation program in response to supervisory concerns raised by European Banking Authority (EBA) around regulatory

reports; Common Reporting (COREP) and Financial Reporting (FINREP).

Worked with Operations and Technology partners to investigate and understand the data consumption flow - upstream through downstream/ end-to-end. • Investigated Metadata/ data elements utilized for derivation logic in downstream systems for COREP and FINREP. • Created and simplified data taxonomy exhibiting hierarchical data classification/structure and ownership across EMEA entities/ business functions. • Documented findings related to data concerns around credit system(s) limitations, capital adequacy concerns, Operations process limitations, off- balance sheet items with Internal Audit and Compliance partners.

Concluded with internal testing/ reviewing of COREP and FINREP raw data evidencing key attributes and values as per EBA regulations.

FR 2052a Regulatory Data Procure Request - NAM entities focused

08/2021 - 11/2022

In response to Matter Requiring Attention (MRAs) raised by OCC in 2020, FRB stepped in to conduct a firmwide exam focusing on FR 2052a. • FRB selected about 2,000 high-liquid accounts/ trades such as deposit, saving, cash, Equities, SFT, ETD, OTC, and Loans. • FRB tasked firm with procurement of legal documentation verifying the key attributes and values reported via FR 2052a submission within 90-business day period.

About 70 team members sourced more than 5,000 documents/ artifacts: including account opening forms, KYC documentation, loan/credit agreements,

trade confirmations, internal trade blotters, Bloomberg tickets, and LCH clearing tickets, etc. evidencing the key attributes and reported values.

Submitted write-up and business justification in response to open questions from Federal Reserve Bank. • Tracked progress in conjunction with PMO by recording number of trades and sourced documentation for each leveraging a centralized Metric and SharePoint visible to all Senior Stakeholders.

With 100% documentation and write-up for requested PIDs/Transactions, demonstrated firm's robust system and capacity to trace back to source

documentation evidencing key attributes and values for FR 2052a liquidity report.

Education

University Of Mumbai Bachelor's Degree in Commerce

Mumbai, India 06/2011 - 05/2014

Foundation in Business, Finance, Accounting, and Management Principles

Indian Institute of Management Bangalore Banking and Financial Markets - Risk Perspective

Mumbai, India 01/2026 - Present

Capital Markets, Risk Management, Basel 1, 2, 3 reforms, Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governance

London School of Business Administration Risk Management Program

Mumbai, India 12/2025 - Present

Credit, Market, Operational/ Business Operations and Liquidity Risks

Certifications

Finance & Quantitative Modeling for Analysts Specialization

University of Pennsylvania via Coursera Investment

Banking: Financial Analysis and Valuation

University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign via Coursera Regulatory

Compliance Specialization

University of Pennsylvania via Coursera

Statistics with SAS

SAS via Coursera

About 70 team members sourced more than 5,000 documents/ artifacts: including account opening forms, KYC documentation, loan/credit agreements,
trade confirmations, internal trade blotters, Bloomberg tickets, and LCH clearing tickets, etc. evidencing the key attributes and reported values.
Submitted write-up and business justification in response to open questions from Federal Reserve Bank. • Tracked progress in conjunction with PMO by recording number of trades and sourced documentation for each leveraging a centralized Metric and SharePoint visible to all Senior Stakeholders.
With 100% documentation and write-up for requested PIDs/Transactions, demonstrated firm's robust system and capacity to trace back to source
documentation evidencing key attributes and values for FR 2052a liquidity report.
